enabled_by: enabled or started from an install scriptlet

scriptlets.body:
if [ -f /usr/share/applications/harbour-whatsapp-sailfish.desktop ]; then
    prepared=0
    for marker in /home/*/.local/share/harbour-whatsup/.whatsup-beta-migration.json; do
        if [ -f "$marker" ] && grep -q '"oldId":"harbour-whatsapp-sailfish"' "$marker"; then
            prepared=1
            break
        fi
    done
    if [ "$prepared" -ne 1 ]; then
        echo 'Run WhatsUp Migrator before replacing the beta app.' >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi

if [ "$1" -gt 1 ]; then
    systemctl-user stop harbour-whatsapp-sailfish-daemon.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
    systemctl-user disable harbour-whatsapp-sailfish-daemon.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
    systemctl-user stop harbour-whatsapp-sailfish-call-overlay.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
    systemctl-user stop harbour-whatsapp-sailfish-screencast.socket harbour-whatsapp-sailfish-screencast.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
fi
systemctl daemon-reload >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
systemctl reload dbus.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
update-desktop-database /usr/share/applications >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
sailfish-share-update-cache >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
systemctl-user daemon-reload >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
if [ "$1" -eq 1 ]; then
    systemctl-user enable harbour-whatsup-daemon.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
fi
systemctl-user restart harbour-whatsup-daemon.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
pkill -f '^/usr/libexec/harbour-whatsup-diagnostics$' >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
systemctl-user stop harbour-whatsup-call-overlay.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
systemctl-user disable harbour-whatsup-call-overlay.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :

if [ "$1" -eq 0 ]; then
    systemctl-user stop harbour-whatsup-daemon.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
    systemctl-user disable harbour-whatsup-daemon.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
    systemctl-user stop harbour-whatsup-call-overlay.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
    systemctl-user disable harbour-whatsup-call-overlay.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
    systemctl-user stop harbour-whatsup-screencast.socket harbour-whatsup-screencast.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
fi

if [ "$1" -eq 0 ]; then
    systemctl daemon-reload >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
    update-desktop-database /usr/share/applications >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
    sailfish-share-update-cache >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
    systemctl-user daemon-reload >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
fi

systemctl-user daemon-reload >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
systemctl-user unmask --runtime harbour-whatsup-daemon.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
systemctl-user restart harbour-whatsup-daemon.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
